assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent dizziness that have persisted despite initial medical management.
There is clinical suspicion of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, atrial fibrillation, and sick sinus syndrome.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate these symptoms with underlying arrhythmic events.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the diagnoses I47.1, I48.91, and I49.5.
